recommendation: Keep this no-change audit for the current FHIR core branch. If HL7 wants to repair historical R5 download artifacts or reintroduce generated profile Questionnaires, handle that as separate publication maintenance or Kindling/publisher work with explicit que-2 validation.
issue_request: FHIR-37448 was Published/Persuasive for R5 after reporting that generated Questionnaire examples in the JSON examples download violated Questionnaire invariant que-2 by repeating linkId values for choice-type elements, including ActivityDefinition.timing[x]._null and SupplyDelivery.occurrence[x]._null.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged FHIR source commit for FHIR-37448 was found. The R5 published examples-json.zip still contains generated per-resource Questionnaire JSON files and many still violate que-2, so the R5 artifact was not corrected in-place.
additional_context: The affected files were generated by the external Kindling publisher dependency rather than checked-in FHIR source. Current FHIR source still builds downloads.html and active Questionnaire/ActivityDefinition resources, but current build.fhir.org examples-json.zip no longer contains generated per-resource *-questionnaire.json files. Kindling commit cc11a2d18bc89191caf59af41f73823d04b6fdf2 removed questionnaire generation functionality, and FHIR later upgraded to that Kindling line.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current downloadable JSON examples contain only seven Questionnaire resources and none have duplicate linkId values; the only local source duplicate found was the intentional que-2 failure test fixture.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive R5 correction reporting duplicate linkId values in generated JSON Questionnaire examples from the downloads page.
evidence_items.learned: The issue request targets generated download artifacts for resource/profile Questionnaires, especially choice-type linkId generation.

evidence_items.summary: The checked-in FHIR source delegates publication to org.hl7.fhir:kindling, exposes examples-json.zip on Downloads, and still includes active Questionnaire and ActivityDefinition resources.
evidence_items.learned: The affected examples ZIP is a generated publication artifact, while the relevant pages/resources remain in current build scope.

evidence_items.command: curl -fsSL https://build.fhir.org/examples-json.zip; inspect ZIP names and check Questionnaire.item.linkId duplicates
evidence_items.summary: The current CI examples ZIP contains zero generated per-resource *-questionnaire.json files and seven Questionnaire resources, none with duplicate linkId values.
evidence_items.learned: The current publication surface no longer has the invalid generated Questionnaire examples reported by FHIR-37448.

evidence_items.summary: The R5 examples ZIP contains 221 generated Questionnaire files and 161 have duplicate linkIds, including activitydefinition-questionnaire.json and supplydelivery-questionnaire.json.
evidence_items.learned: The original defect was real in R5 output, but that historical artifact is not corrected by current FHIR source edits.

evidence_items.summary: Kindling removed processQuestionnaire and the calls that serialized generated resource/profile Questionnaires; FHIR later upgraded to the corresponding Kindling line.
evidence_items.learned: Current correctness is explained by removal of the generator path, so no FHIR source definition change is needed.
